For centuries, Mine XVIT had been an anomaly among anomalies... a cursed pocket of petrified impenetrable dark alloy that swallowed pickaxes and turned the blades of mountain ogres into blunt iron spoons.
It was a seamless tomb of cold ore that laughed at force.
Nothing short of the ancient earth-dragons or the apocalyptic breath of a high-tier calamity was supposed to leave so much as a hairline groove upon its skin.
Yet now, the entire peak was groaning.
KRRRRRR-GRIND!
Deep within the fracture colossal roots as thick as the ancient watchtowers of imperial citadels twisted and bunched like the flexing pythons of an ancient forest god.

They were not mundane pine or rot-resistant cedar... they glowed with a breathtaking emerald fire that bled clean through the snow-mist, illuminating the jagged rock face in an unearthly midsummer twilight.
The bird’s scythe-curved beak clicked open slightly.
A strange ratcheting noise like the grinding of copper gears rattled deep in its throat.
Through a jagged split where the mountain’s crust had parted beneath the swelling timber, the avian caught sight of the figures standing inside the cavern vault.
There was the woman in emerald green.

She did not sweat, nor did she strain her back against the bedrock as she merely stood with one slender hand resting against a smooth wooden staff, her long moss-tinted hair billowing lazily in an ethereal draft that had no right existing fifty yards underground.
The mana pouring off her slender shoulders was not the aggressive aura of a martial artist, nor was it the volatile flame of a common basin mage... it was deep and vast as an ocean of living sap.
It possessed the slow terrifying inevitability of tectonic drift.
’She is...’ The bird’s crested head tilted sharply to the left, its black pupils contracting to pinpoint specks. ’She is stronger than the Lord.’
It had observed Silas Graves.
It had watched the black-haired Lord on multiple occasions but this woman... this green-clad pillar of vitality wasn’t merely wielding power.
She was the power, an ancient, primordial spirit wrapped in mortal skin.
Next to her stood another female... a tall warrior wrapped in dark furs and salt-worn leather with a weapon resting against her hip.

That one looked strange; her cheeks were violently flushed an indignant crimson, her boots stomping the ground as she barked at the green woman with her jaw tight and her fists clenched like an embarrassed child.
Yet beneath that ridiculous undignified display of flushed cheeks and fluttering fury, the bird could smell the iron in her blood.
’...Strong.’
They were both monsters as they possessed more than enough raw conceptual weight to shatter the impenetrable.
’The ice...’
The bird’s thoughts raced with frantic clarity.
Down in the lightless absolute-zero depths of the northern trench, where the ancient glacier refused to yield even a single millimeter, its master was still waiting.
She was frozen to her collarbone, coughing up bitter frost, and threatening to turn every feather on its wings into roasted skewers if it didn’t return with salvation.

The Lord with the golden blade had an army, and that army smelled of sharp steel, suspicion, and arrows that would pin a curious bird to a pine trunk before it could utter three squawks but this woman?
This woman made of nature?
Surely a being of nature would understand the language of beasts!
Surely she wouldn’t immediately loose a volley of arrows at a messenger!
’I will tell her,’ the bird resolved, its wings trembling with renewed urgency. ’I will fly through the crack, land upon that wooden staff, and screech the coordinates until she follows...’
SNAP!
The bird kicked off from the basalt ledge, its dark, blade-like wings catching the howling updraft with a muted hiss.
It folded its plumage tight, diving like a black dart through the falling snow, aiming straight for the gaping fissure in the ceiling of Mine XVIT.
Thirty yards...
Twenty yards...
The fragrant scent of crushed pine blasted upward from the cavern throat.
The bird opened its scythe-beak, drawing freezing air into its hollow chest to loose its desperate high-pitched plea.
’Squaaaa—’
It never got the chance.
Far down within the bowels of the alloy cavern, the emerald roots encountered a stubborn node.
Deep within the eastern foundation of the mountain, a colossal pillar of hyper-compressed star-ore resisted the spiritual intrusion.
The root didn’t yield... it constricted, surging with an apocalyptic burst of divine vitality that violently bypassed the material threshold.
KRA-BOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!
The collision detonated an atmospheric shockwave of pure pressure!
FWOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOSH!
A concussive column of pressurized air, pulverized granite dust, and screaming emerald mana erupted upward through the roof fracture like the exhaust of an imperial siege cannon.
"SKREEEEEEEEEEEK?!"
The obsidian bird was caught dead in the center of the vertical gale.
The concussive force slapped it out of the sky before its vocal cords could finish a single syllable.
Its feathers ruffled violently, its scythe-curved beak was forced shut by three hundred pounds of atmospheric thrust, and its beady eyes rolled backward in panic.
WHOOOOOOSH...
ZOOOOOM!
Like a pebble skipped off a catapult arm, the bird was launched backward through the blizzard at supersonic velocity.
It tumbled end-over-end through the bruised clouds, shrieking silently as the jagged terrain of the outer basin blurred into a white streak beneath its tailfeathers.
It was hurled miles to the north, screaming through the sky on a trajectory that carried it straight back toward the suffocating, frozen canyons from whence it had flown.
Down in the illuminated belly of Mine XVIT, the emerald light finally began to settle.
The air was dense with the warm rich fragrance of crushed pine needles...
Where there had once been a dark, impenetrable dome of seamless slate-gray alloy, there was now open, yawning space.
"Step back toward the threshold, girls," Eluned’s voice chimed with effortless serenity, carrying over the muffled thud of falling pebbles.
"Bring the construct out to the approach ramp and mind the shale."
The ten women who formed the extraction detachment scrambled toward the entrance, their boots slipping slightly on the pulverized dust.
Walking in their midst with heavy, earth-trembling steps was the colossal Phase 1 Titan Golem.

The four-legged stone behemoth, tall as an imperial watchtower, navigated the widening mouth of the cave, its massive amber optics pulsing with a dull compliant hum as it positioned its expansive alloy bins just outside the main chamber.
Once the last boot had cleared the interior perimeter, Eluned gently raised the tip of her wooden staff.
CRRR-CRUNCH!
The emerald roots tightened in a final majestic contraction.
Like a thousand living wooden fingers peeling an orange, the massive roots methodically crushed the remaining structural shell of the cavern but it was not mindless devastation.
The divine mana guided the fracture lines, breaking the impenetrable slate-gray alloy into clean, uniform rectangular blocks roughly the size of travel trunks.
Then, with an eerie weightless grace that defied every law of physics, the glowing roots shifted.
They scooped through the rubble, cradling hundreds of tons of high-density ore, and lifted them smoothly through the cracked ceiling.
THUD!
CLANG!
RATTLE!
One after another, the massive slabs of virgin alloy were neatly deposited directly into the reinforced transport bins bolted across the Phase 1 Titan Golem’s back.
The heavy-duty suspension of the construct hissed, venting plumes of pressurized steam as the bins rapidly filled with millions of credits’ worth of pristine unmarred ore.
Within three minutes, the roots unraveled.
They shrank back into the earth with a soft, rustling sigh, leaving behind a perfectly hollowed-out, clean-swept rock bed.
Not a single pebble of the mysterious alloy remained...
The entire deposit had been extracted, cataloged by spiritual force, and stacked into the golem’s bins without a single pickaxe striking the rock.
Eluned turned around, a serene radiant smile gracing her porcelain features as she smoothed the emerald folds of her dress.
"There," Eluned announced softly, her hands folding neatly over her staff.
"A most efficient extraction...
The mountain has yielded its bounty to Blessed Land."
She paused as the cavern threshold was dead silent.
Standing beside the laden golem, Bodil the dwarven miner was staring at the empty cavern floor with her jaw hanging so slack it nearly brushed the leather collar of her harness.
Her master-forged steel pickaxe dangled limply from her calloused hand, completely forgotten.
Behind her, the other women stood in frozen unblinking rows.
Their leather straps were still pristine and their hands were completely free of rock dust.
Their sweat hadn’t even begun to warm the steel-mesh fabric clinging to their skin and beside them stood Morwenna.
The Pirate Queen slowly lowered the hand that had been resting on her weapon, her amber eyes widening before narrowing into a look of delight.
A slow wicked grin spread across her face, revealing sharp gleaming teeth.
Miss Eluned?" Bodil squeaked, her raspy dwarven voice cracking slightly in the cold air.
"Yes, Bodil?" Eluned tilted her head, maintaining her tranquil saintly composure.
"You... you did it all," Bodil stammered, gesturing with the blunt end of her pickaxe toward the immaculate, empty pit.
"Every scrap...
The whole bloody node..."
A tall blonde woman stepped forward, her eyebrows furrowing as a look of soul-deep panic began to dawn on her youthful face.
"Wait..." the recruit muttered, looking down at her spotless hands, and then looking up at the filled bins on the golem’s back.
"If you just... ripped the whole mine out with your roots in two minutes... what about the ledger?"
"The ledger?" another girl gasped, her eyes widening in horror.
"The Lord’s morning decree!
He said the reward goes to whoever mines the most!
Whoever sweats for the territory!"
"We didn’t swing a single pick!" a third woman shouted, her voice rising into an anxious wail.
"We haven’t logged a single pound of ore under our names!
How are we supposed to win the Lord’s reward if the Goddess just solod the entire damn mountain?!"
"I wanted to earn that reward!"
"I bought this new lavender oil from the apothecary just for tonight!"
"Miss Eluned, that’s completely unfair!"
A cacophony of bitter heartbroken complaints erupted from the vanguard ranks.
The girls stomped their boots, waving their unchipped chisels and glaring at the World Spirit with betrayed tearful pouts.
Eluned’s serene smile froze.
A tiny imperceptible bead of cold sweat formed at her temple, sliding slowly down her cheek.
She reached up, her slender fingers delicately clenching around the collar of her robes, her breath hitching in her throat.
I’m an idiot,’ Eluned screamed inwardly, her divine mind screeching to a violent mortified halt. ’I completely forgot!
Silas didn’t send them out here just to haul rocks... this was supposed to be a morale-building team exercise!
He set up that ridiculous competition to motivate them!
If I steal all the credit and leave their ledgers blank, these girls are going to despise me!
They’ll look at me like an overbearing monster who ruined their chances with our Lord!’
Beside the trembling goddess, Morwenna’s grin was practically splitting her face in two.
The Pirate Queen crossed her arms over her chest, leaning her hip against the side of the Titan Golem, fairly vibrating with malicious satisfaction.
"Oh, look at that," Morwenna drawled, her voice dripping with venomous amusement.
"The grand Goddess... so eager to show off her pretty green branches that she forgot basic crew management.
Look at them, Eluned.
You just broke their little hearts.
What are you going to do now?
Weave them some pretty little daisy chains to wipe their tears?"
Eluned’s emerald eyes flared.

’Think, Eluned,’ she told herself, her heart fluttering beneath her ribs. ’You are an ancient divine entity and you have governed ecosystems for a long time so surely you can talk your way out of a pack of sulking women!’
Suddenly, her gaze locked onto the leather satchel hanging from Bodil’s hip.
With the terrifying effortless speed of a high spirit, Eluned’s hand blurred.
SWOOSH.
"Oi!" Bodil yelped as the thick map of the Umbral Basin was neatly plucked from her belt before she could even blink.
Eluned unrolled the map with a dramatic authoritative snap of her wrists, holding it high so that every single woman in the squad could clearly see the markings.
Her expression instantly shifted, returning to the radiant and confident composure of a wise benevolent elder sister.
"Calm yourselves, my lovely warriors," Eluned announced, her voice ringing out like silver chimes and instantly cutting through the grumbling.
"Do you truly think I would rob you of your glory?
Do you take me for a callous thief of your rightful rewards?"

chapters.title: Chapter 482: Sweet Mouthed Tree Witch
paragraphs: The girls blinked, sniffling slightly with their angry murmurs dying down as they looked at the map.

"I cleared Mine XVIT intentionally," Eluned stated with conviction. "This particular deposit was an anomalous structural aberration... an impenetrable alloy that would have broken your tools and exhausted your stamina before midday. I removed the obstacle so we wouldn’t waste time!"
She pointed a pale elegant finger at the sprawling grid of the Umbral Basin.

"Look closely at the survey," Eluned continued, her eyes scanning the marks. "Blessed Land has roughly one hundred and forty-seven capable women under arms. More than a hundred of us were deployed across the basin this morning, divided into various extraction squads, while the rest remained behind to guard the walls and tend the keep. That means most sectors are completely empty right now!"
She tapped several distinct circles drawn across the northern and eastern ridges.

"Look at these nodes," Eluned urged, turning the parchment toward the women. "There are mines marked with an ’O’ for confirmed surface yields, and mines marked with an ’X’ that our scouts haven’t even touched yet and look at our golem!"
She gestured toward the massive Phase 1 construct.

"Our Lord entrusted us with a Phase 1 Titan Golem... the largest, most powerful transport engine in the entire territory! Mine XVIT was rich, but look at the bins! It is barely one-third full! Silas did not give us this titan expecting a single haul! If we return right now, we are wasting seventy percent of its capacity!"
A ripple of sudden realization passed through the crowd.
Eluned stepped forward, her voice swelling with inspiring seductive warmth.

"If we move right now... if we march across these unassigned sectors and strike three, four, perhaps five more caverns then every single one of you can fill your ledgers to overflowing! You won’t just match the other squads... you will dwarf them! When we roll back through the gates of Blessed Land at sunset, Lord Silas will not be looking at Tasmin’s little carts or Brida’s dented scrap! He will be looking at an entire mountain of treasure delivered by our hands and he will have no choice but to reward every single woman who swung a pick in this detachment!"
For a second, the girls stood frozen then, their eyes lit up with wild ambition.
"She’s right!" the blonde recruit gasped, pumping her pickaxe into the air. "The Titan has two more empty bins!"
"We can hit the iron crags at Sector Nine!"
"Let’s strip the whole basin bare!"
"To the wolves!"
A roaring unified cheer erupted from the squad, completely washing away the previous resentment.
The women scrambled toward their mounts, their boots churning the snow as they checked their straps with renewed energy.
Bodil rubbed her soot-stained chin, letting out an appreciative dwarven whistle.
"Well, stone me sideways... she’s not just a pretty face. That was smooth as oiled gears."
Beside her, Morwenna’s mouth opened and closed silently.
Her throat clicked with a dry frustrated hitch as she stared at the cheering girls as her glorious moment of mockery completely snatched from her grasp.
’Damn smooth-talking tree-witch,’ Morwenna scowled internally.

"Well?" Morwenna called out, clearing her throat aggressively and scowling at the eager women. "What are you standing around gaping for?! Pick a bloody mark on the map and let’s move before the blizzard swallows the tracks!"
"Sector Nine-B!" the vanguard girls shouted in unison. "The upper vein!"
"Then mount up!" Eluned commanded brightly, gracefully stepping onto the saddle of her Blessed Wolf. "Titan Golem, follow the vanguard column with full stride!"
CLANG-HISS!
The massive Phase 1 construct lurched forward, its four colossal stone legs falling into a steady movement behind the cavalry.
The ten women surged out into the howling wind, their wolf mounts bounding through the snowdrifts like silver phantoms.
As the column picked up speed, Morwenna kicked her mount into a gallop, pulling up directly alongside Eluned’s right flank.
The Pirate Queen leaned over her wolf’s neck, a bitter taunting smirk curling her lips as her messy hair whipped in the icy gale.

"Don’t think I didn’t see you sweating, light-weed," Morwenna mocked, raising her voice over the whistling storm. "You panicked and your little saintly mask cracked right down the middle. If I hadn’t kept my mouth shut, those girls would have fed your wooden staff to the forge fires..."
Eluned didn’t look flustered in the slightest.
She sat side-saddle with divine effortless poise, the wind somehow parting around her emerald robes without chilling her skin.
Slowly, she turned her head, fixing Morwenna with a breathtakingly serene gaze.
She reached out across the gap, placing one warm and perfectly manicured hand upon Morwenna’s leather-clad shoulder.

"I handled my flock as a shepherd should, Morwenna," Eluned murmured softly, her voice rich with mocking sweetness. "And unlike you, I am going to cash in on that reward tonight. Silas likes women who take care of his people..."
Morwenna’s brow furrowed, a suspicious growl catching in her throat.
"What’s that supposed to mean—"
Eluned leaned in slightly, her green eyes flashing with mischief.
"It means you are still a virgin, Hehe~" Eluned whispered smoothly, patting her shoulder twice with patronizing tenderness. "Come talk to me about men after you’ve finally lost it."
SWOOSH!
Eluned tapped the flank of her Blessed Wolf, and the divine beast surged forward with a sudden blinding burst of golden speed, leaving Morwenna eating a cloud of churned snow.
The violent draft whipped across Morwenna’s face, sending her hair swaying wildly in the freezing wind.
The Pirate Queen froze in the saddle, her jaw dropping and her eyes burning with a fury so apocalyptic it could have melted the northern glaciers.
Her cheeks turned an volcanic shade of purple-red.

"YOU... YOU ARROGANT, MOSS-COVERED WHORE!" Morwenna shrieked into the howling storm, drawing Tidebringer halfway from its sheath with a wild vibrating screech of steel! "I WILL CHOP YOU INTO KINDLING! I WILL BURN YOUR ROOTS FOR CHARCOAL! GET BACK HERE!"
She kicked her mount furiously, tearing through the snowdrifts in hot, murderous pursuit.
Meanwhile, far to the south, beneath the towering limestone ridges of the inner mountains, Cavern KB-22 was alive with the group in it.
Silas stood just inside the threshold of the hidden geode, letting out a long exasperated sigh.
"Haah..."
He reached down with both hands, aggressively tugging at the thick leather straps cinching across his ribcage.
He pulled the heavy iron buckle through the notch, grunting as the reinforced fabric snapped tightly against his chest, outlining the hard chiseled musculature of his torso like a second skin.

The territory’s tailor had done an exceptional job crafting the custom dwarven-tradition mining suits... complete with dense leather harnesses and fine steel-mesh underlays but the sizing was something else entirely.
Silas turned his head, casting a sharp dry look over his shoulder.
Standing beside an oversized tool crate was Thora.
The dwarven forge master was completely clean-faced, her skin soot-stained and pale eyes sparkling with shameless dwarven mirth as she adjusted her own gear.

"Thora," Silas muttered, his tone caught between deep irritation and amused disbelief. "Why in the hell is this uniform so tight around the groin and shoulders? I asked for flexible mining gear, not a corset."
Thora paused, her cheeks lighting up with an immediate radiant flush that had nothing to do with forge heat.
A wicked unrepentant smirk split across her clean-shaven face as she let her gaze shamelessly drop down the front of his trousers.

"Well, my Lord," Thora drawled, rolling her shoulders with a low chuckle, "when you’re hauling high-density earth ores, you need proper structural support for your vital assets! Wouldn’t want anything... swinging loose and getting crushed between two boulders, now would we? Besides, a tight fit keeps the blood flowing where a man needs it most!"
Silas stared at her for a flat deadpan second.
Without saying a single word, he stepped forward, raised his right hand, and snapped his index finger against the dwarven woman’s forehead with a crisp flick.
CLACK!
"Ow!" Thora yelped, clutching her forehead and hopping backward, though her grin remained completely intact. "Violence against your master smith! That’s a territorial crime, Lord Silas!"
"Keep your mind on the anvil, Thora," Silas rolled his eyes, adjusting the straps on his thighs one last time.
They were standing in the narrow concealed passage that the Princess had accidentally unlocked the previous afternoon.

Behind them, resting comfortably in the wide, cleared dome where the goblin settlement had once stood, the colossal Phase 1 Titan Golem lay flat on its belly, its massive reinforced alloy bins waiting patiently for the day’s extraction.
"Look at mine, my Lord!" Thora protested, pointing down at her own dark suit. "Mine’s tighter than a cellar door in a flood! See? The leather is pinching my ribs! It’s tradition, I tell you!"
Silas simply shook his head, focusing his attention forward as the rest of the extraction team gathered at the entrance of the dazzling geode.
Stepping out from behind a jagged stalagmite, having just finished fastening the final buckles of her mining harness, was Thor.
Silas’s eyes inadvertently locked onto the demigoddess, and for a split second, his breath caught in his throat.
The custom mining attire on a standard girl was striking, but on the God of Thunder, it was a visual catastrophe.
The tight, flexible stretch-fabric was strained to its microscopic limit across her towering, athletic frame.
The dark leather harness crossed over her gravity-defying chest, pushing her massive pale cleavage upward until it spilled shamelessly over the reinforced neckline.
Her sculpted abdominal muscles rippled beneath the dark mesh with every breath, and the tight leather trousers clung ruthlessly to her thick powerful thighs and hips.
’I have a feeling Thora has something to do with this...’𝒻𝑟𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝑛𝘰𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝘤𝘰𝘮
She carried herself with the wild confidence of an immortal warrior, her long blonde hair tied back in a messy warrior’s knot.
Silas immediately cleared his throat, violently snapping his gaze to the left to stare intently at a completely unremarkable patch of gray limestone.
"GWAHAHAHAHA!" Thor’s booming, thunderous laughter echoed off the high crystalline ceiling, shaking loose a shower of sparkling dust.
She caught Silas’s sudden flustered evasion instantly.
Striding forward with massive confident steps, she planted her heavy hands on her hips, thrusting her chest out proudly as she leaned down toward him.

"What’s the matter, Lord?!" Thor teased, her storm-blue eyes flashing with playful mirth. "Does the armor of the mountain make you nervous? I thought you mortal kings were fond of bountiful harvests! I am glad to see you appreciate the divine proportions of Asgard! Look all you wish... a great warrior should never hide her strength!"
Standing barely five paces away, the Princess slowly looked down at her own chest.
The twenty-five-year-old royal maiden was wearing the exact same custom-tailored leather harness.
The straps fit her slender elegant frame perfectly, accentuating her narrow waist and the modest delicate curve of her bosom.
She was not flat by any normal mortal metric since her royal upbringing had blessed her with a graceful shapely figure.
Yet, as she looked at her own chest, and then looked up at Thor’s armor-straining twin peaks, the Princess’s expression withered into a look of soul-crushing despair.

’...I might as well be an ironing board,’ the Princess thought miserably, her azure hair drooping around her flushed cheeks as she crossed her arms over her chest, trying desperately to hide her modest curves. ’How is that physically possible? Does divine food go straight to the ribs?’
"A warrior’s worth is measured by her purity and discipline, not her excess mass, Princess," a soft tranquil voice chimed gently.
Stepping into the light of the Mana Diamonds was Aurelia.
The former Saintess of the Argent Flame looked breathtakingly magnificent.
Even in the tight, dark leather of dwarven mining gear, Aurelia carried an aura of untouchable elegance.
The dark straps contrasted starkly against her pale porcelain skin, framing her toned shoulders and slender collarbones with razor-sharp perfection.
Her golden eyes sparkled with serene warmth, and her pristine white under-tunic glowed under the mana of the cavern.
Beside her, Vala and Reina were adjusting their thigh sheaths.
Vala’s dark shadowed presence was sharp as a sword with her tight gear accentuating her lean physique, while Reina’s athletic wolf-riding frame was much fuller.
Silas took a deep breath, forcing his composure back into place.
He clapped his hands together, the sharp crack echoing off the shimmering walls of the geode.

"Alright, that’s enough posturing," Silas announced, his voice carrying the firm weight of command. "We have thousands of tons of high-grade Mana Diamonds to extract, and we have a schedule to keep... Thora, gather everyone around. It’s time for your demonstration."

I WILL BURN YOUR ROOTS FOR CHARCOAL!
GET BACK HERE!"
She kicked her mount furiously, tearing through the snowdrifts in hot, murderous pursuit.
Meanwhile, far to the south, beneath the towering limestone ridges of the inner mountains, Cavern KB-22 was alive with the group in it.
Silas stood just inside the threshold of the hidden geode, letting out a long exasperated sigh.
"Haah..."
He reached down with both hands, aggressively tugging at the thick leather straps cinching across his ribcage.
He pulled the heavy iron buckle through the notch, grunting as the reinforced fabric snapped tightly against his chest, outlining the hard chiseled musculature of his torso like a second skin.

The territory’s tailor had done an exceptional job crafting the custom dwarven-tradition mining suits... complete with dense leather harnesses and fine steel-mesh underlays but the sizing was something else entirely.
Silas turned his head, casting a sharp dry look over his shoulder.
Standing beside an oversized tool crate was Thora.
The dwarven forge master was completely clean-faced, her skin soot-stained and pale eyes sparkling with shameless dwarven mirth as she adjusted her own gear.
"Thora," Silas muttered, his tone caught between deep irritation and amused disbelief.
"Why in the hell is this uniform so tight around the groin and shoulders?
I asked for flexible mining gear, not a corset."
Thora paused, her cheeks lighting up with an immediate radiant flush that had nothing to do with forge heat.
A wicked unrepentant smirk split across her clean-shaven face as she let her gaze shamelessly drop down the front of his trousers.
"Well, my Lord," Thora drawled, rolling her shoulders with a low chuckle, "when you’re hauling high-density earth ores, you need proper structural support for your vital assets!
Wouldn’t want anything... swinging loose and getting crushed between two boulders, now would we?
Besides, a tight fit keeps the blood flowing where a man needs it most!"
Silas stared at her for a flat deadpan second.
Without saying a single word, he stepped forward, raised his right hand, and snapped his index finger against the dwarven woman’s forehead with a crisp flick.
CLACK!
"Ow!" Thora yelped, clutching her forehead and hopping backward, though her grin remained completely intact.
"Violence against your master smith!
That’s a territorial crime, Lord Silas!"
"Keep your mind on the anvil, Thora," Silas rolled his eyes, adjusting the straps on his thighs one last time.
They were standing in the narrow concealed passage that the Princess had accidentally unlocked the previous afternoon.

Behind them, resting comfortably in the wide, cleared dome where the goblin settlement had once stood, the colossal Phase 1 Titan Golem lay flat on its belly, its massive reinforced alloy bins waiting patiently for the day’s extraction.
"Look at mine, my Lord!" Thora protested, pointing down at her own dark suit.
"Mine’s tighter than a cellar door in a flood!
See?
The leather is pinching my ribs!
It’s tradition, I tell you!"
Silas simply shook his head, focusing his attention forward as the rest of the extraction team gathered at the entrance of the dazzling geode.
Stepping out from behind a jagged stalagmite, having just finished fastening the final buckles of her mining harness, was Thor.
Silas’s eyes inadvertently locked onto the demigoddess, and for a split second, his breath caught in his throat.
The custom mining attire on a standard girl was striking, but on the God of Thunder, it was a visual catastrophe.
The tight, flexible stretch-fabric was strained to its microscopic limit across her towering, athletic frame.
The dark leather harness crossed over her gravity-defying chest, pushing her massive pale cleavage upward until it spilled shamelessly over the reinforced neckline.
Her sculpted abdominal muscles rippled beneath the dark mesh with every breath, and the tight leather trousers clung ruthlessly to her thick powerful thighs and hips.
’I have a feeling Thora has something to do with this...’𝒻𝑟𝘦𝘦𝘸ℯ𝒷𝑛𝘰𝓋ℯ𝘭.𝘤𝘰𝘮
She carried herself with the wild confidence of an immortal warrior, her long blonde hair tied back in a messy warrior’s knot.
Silas immediately cleared his throat, violently snapping his gaze to the left to stare intently at a completely unremarkable patch of gray limestone.
"GWAHAHAHAHA!" Thor’s booming, thunderous laughter echoed off the high crystalline ceiling, shaking loose a shower of sparkling dust.
She caught Silas’s sudden flustered evasion instantly.
Striding forward with massive confident steps, she planted her heavy hands on her hips, thrusting her chest out proudly as she leaned down toward him.
"What’s the matter, Lord?!" Thor teased, her storm-blue eyes flashing with playful mirth.
"Does the armor of the mountain make you nervous?
I thought you mortal kings were fond of bountiful harvests!
I am glad to see you appreciate the divine proportions of Asgard!
Look all you wish... a great warrior should never hide her strength!"
Standing barely five paces away, the Princess slowly looked down at her own chest.
The twenty-five-year-old royal maiden was wearing the exact same custom-tailored leather harness.
The straps fit her slender elegant frame perfectly, accentuating her narrow waist and the modest delicate curve of her bosom.
She was not flat by any normal mortal metric since her royal upbringing had blessed her with a graceful shapely figure.
Yet, as she looked at her own chest, and then looked up at Thor’s armor-straining twin peaks, the Princess’s expression withered into a look of soul-crushing despair.

’...I might as well be an ironing board,’ the Princess thought miserably, her azure hair drooping around her flushed cheeks as she crossed her arms over her chest, trying desperately to hide her modest curves. ’How is that physically possible?
Does divine food go straight to the ribs?’
"A warrior’s worth is measured by her purity and discipline, not her excess mass, Princess," a soft tranquil voice chimed gently.
Stepping into the light of the Mana Diamonds was Aurelia.
The former Saintess of the Argent Flame looked breathtakingly magnificent.
Even in the tight, dark leather of dwarven mining gear, Aurelia carried an aura of untouchable elegance.
The dark straps contrasted starkly against her pale porcelain skin, framing her toned shoulders and slender collarbones with razor-sharp perfection.
Her golden eyes sparkled with serene warmth, and her pristine white under-tunic glowed under the mana of the cavern.
Beside her, Vala and Reina were adjusting their thigh sheaths.
Vala’s dark shadowed presence was sharp as a sword with her tight gear accentuating her lean physique, while Reina’s athletic wolf-riding frame was much fuller.
Silas took a deep breath, forcing his composure back into place.
He clapped his hands together, the sharp crack echoing off the shimmering walls of the geode.
"Alright, that’s enough posturing," Silas announced, his voice carrying the firm weight of command.
"We have thousands of tons of high-grade Mana Diamonds to extract, and we have a schedule to keep...
Thora, gather everyone around.
It’s time for your demonstration."

chapters.title: Chapter 483: Mining KB-22
paragraphs: Silas walked over to the primary tool rack resting on the floor, hoisting a heavy, runic-forged dwarven pickaxe.
He stepped forward into the kaleidoscopic light, with Thor, the Princess, Aurelia, and the women gathering in a tight semicircle around him.
Thora stepped into the center of the ring, her face instantly shedding all lewdness, replaced by the stern sacred focus of a dwarven master craftswoman.

"Listen closely, all of you!" Thora barked, holding up a polished steel pickaxe. "Mining is not ditch-digging... It is not swinging a warhammer into an orc’s skull! In my clan, mining is treated as a sacred craft discipline. Remember the golden rule which I’ve distributed to the other dwarves... You don’t fight the mountain... You simply read it."
She walked up to a smooth vertical slab of limestone where a massive cluster of brilliant cerulean Mana Diamonds jutted from the rock like crystalline fruit.

"Step one," Thora commanded, pressing her bare soot-stained palm flat against the cold limestone. "Bare flesh to the rock with no gloves and close your eyes too. You have to feel the internal grain of the stone, the exact same way a master carpenter reads the grain in ironwood! The mana creates micro-vibrations so you must feel where the earth wants to part."
The Princess and the recruits leaned in, their eyes wide as they watched the dwarf.

"Step two," Thora continued, opening her eyes and tracing a blunt finger along a faint grayish streak running roughly eight inches below the blue crystals. "Look right here... This discolored track is what we call the bleed-line. When high-density mana crystals sit in bedrock for centuries, their internal spiritual heat slowly pushes impurities outward into this specific fault path so now... mark this down in your skulls. Never strike the bleed-line directly!"
"Why not?" Thor asked, crossing her massive arms, genuinely curious.
’Thor did mention that she didn’t know how to mine.’ Silas thought with a sigh.

"Because if you strike the bleed-line directly," Thora explained, glaring up at the tall blonde god, "the shockwave travels straight down the fault path like lightning and violently detonates the crystal lattice behind it... You’ll shatter fifty pounds of flawless Mana Diamonds into worthless inert gray powder before you ever see them!"
Thora raised her pickaxe, stepping back.

"Instead, you measure roughly six inches outside the bleed-line which is riiiiii...ght here." She tapped the limestone with her boot. "And when you swing, you don’t use your back! You don’t channel elemental mana! Pure technique! Let the weight of the forged head do the work, and snap your wrists right at the point of impact!"
Thora took a relaxed fluid stance as she raised the pickaxe in a smooth arc, letting the tool drop.
Right at the bottom of the swing, her wrists snapped.
TINK!
The sharp high-pitched chime resonated cleanly through the vaulted cavern.
A circular hairline fracture spider-webbed outward through the limestone, and with a clean scraping sigh, an entire slab of outer bedrock separated, sliding smoothly to the floor.
Behind it, completely pristine and undamaged, lay three massive glowing cerulean diamonds, humming with concentrated mana.
"That," Thora smirked proudly, "is how a dwarf harvests the earth, It’s technique over brute force."
The recruits cheered, clapping softly in admiration as Thora turned, her amber eyes locking directly onto Thor.

"Alright, giantess," Thora challenged, handing a spare heavy pickaxe to the blonde demigoddess. "You boast of celestial strength! Let’s see if those big arms have any finesse! Give us a demonstration on that section over there!"
Thor grinned, snatching the pickaxe easily with one hand.
"Finesse? Little smith, I am the master of the storm! A simple rock is child’s play!"
Thor stepped up to a protruding wall of limestone heavily encrusted with royal amethyst diamonds.
She pressed her bare palm to the rock, squinting her storm-blue eyes in exaggerated concentration.
"Ah! I see the gray line!" Thor declared proudly.
"Six inches outside it!" Thora warned, taking a step back. "Light touch! Snap the wrists! Don’t swing with your back—"
"I know, I know!" Thor laughed.
Thor raised the heavy dwarven pickaxe high over her right shoulder.
’Let me hold back...’
If she didn’t, she might release the power that had wrestled world-serpents and shattered mountain ranges in Asgard.
She snapped her wrists forward.
KRA-WHACK!
The impact was not a crisp musical tink but a concussive deafening crack of a thunderbolt.
A shockwave of raw, unmitigated kinetic force blasted out from the point of impact, blowing the hair back from Silas’s face and making the recruits shriek as they shielded their eyes.
The pickaxe didn’t strike the limestone like Thora wanted at all, instead the head sank four inches deep into solid bedrock.
CRACK-CRACK-SHATTER!

A violent, jagged fracture shot directly across the fault line as right before their horrified eyes, five massive fist-sized royal amethyst diamonds... worth a small fortune in the markets instantly destabilized.
Their internal crystalline matrices shattered under the brutal shock, violently disintegrating into a shower of worthless, inert gray dust that tumbled down the wall like sand.
Dead silence descended over the geode.
Thor stood frozen, holding the buried pickaxe and blinking down at the pile of gray powder at her boots.
"Uh..." Thor muttered, her voice remarkably small as a nervous sweat broke out across her forehead. "...The rock was softer than I anticipated."
Silas winced, slowly pinching the bridge of his nose.
’Five flawless diamonds... gone in half a second. I hope Thora doesn’t crash ou—’
Beside him, the dwarven forge master completely crashed out.
Her pale, soot-stained face violently flushed into a terrifying shade of volcanic purple.
Her amber eyes bulged in rage, and the veins in her neck strained against her leather collar as she threw both hands into the air.

"YOU BRAINLESS THUNDER-STRUCK BLONDE APE!" Thora screamed, her voice reaching a decibel level that literally vibrated the stalactites overhead! "WHAT DID I JUST SAY?! WHAT DID MY MOUTH LITERALLY JUST SPIT OUT INTO YOUR THICK GOD-EARS?! SIX INCHES OUTSIDE! SNAP THE WRISTS! DO NOT USE POWER!"
"I barely tapped it!" Thor protested defensively, waving her hands. "It was a tap!"

"A TAP?! YOU JUST PULVERIZED FIVE FLAWLESS MANA DIAMONDS INTO PUDDLE-MUD, YOU HEAVY-HANDED HEIFER!" Thora roared, marching straight up to the towering demigoddess and jabbing an angry trembling finger directly into Thor’s massive sternum! "THAT IS THREE WEEKS OF FOUNDRY COAL...! YOU ARE A DISASTER AT MINING!"
Thor, who could have flattened Thora into a red paste with a single flick of her little finger, actually shrank back, visibly intimidated by the raw fury of an insulted dwarven artisan.
"I... I can forge some new ones?" Thor suggested weakly.

"YOU CANNOT FORGE A DIAMOND, YOU CLUELESS TROLL!" Thora shrieked, stamping her steel-toed boot against the bedrock! "THAT’S IT! AS MASTER LOGISTICS OFFICER AND CHIEF OF THE FORGE, I AM INVOKING TERRITORIAL EMBARGO! NO MORE ALE FOR YOU! NOT A SINGLE DROP OF DWARVEN STOUT! AND NO ROASTED BOAR! YOU ARE BANNED FROM THE MESS HALL! YOU GET DRY HARDTACK AND WEED-WATER UNTIL THIS MINE IS EMPTY!"
Thor’s storm-blue eyes went wide as dinner plates.
The terror that had not touched her against frost giants, armies, or primordial beasts instantly seized her divine soul.
’No ale? No roasted boar?!’
THUD!
Without a single shred of divine pride remaining, the towering world-shaking God of Thunder slammed both knees directly onto the limestone gravel, dropping into a groveling kowtow at Thora’s boots.

"HAVE MERCY, MASTER SMITH!" Thor cried out, clasping her massive hands together in desperate pitiful supplication. "Do not take the meat! Do not take the ale! I will be gentle! I will touch the stone like a newborn fawn! I swear upon Mjölnir’s shaft, I will not break another crystal! Please, Thora, have mercy upon a thirsty warrior!"
The Princess stared at the groveling god in utter shock, her hand flying to cover her mouth.
Aurelia closed her eyes, offering a silent prayer of pity, while Vala and Reina struggled violently to suppress their laughter.
Silas stood with his arms crossed, watching the immortal thunder god beg a four-foot-tall dwarf for boar chops with an exhausted smile tugging at his lips.
Thora crossed her arms over her chest, puffing out her cheeks as she glared down at the kneeling demigoddess.
She let the silence stretch for five agonizing seconds, reveling in the terrifying authority of a logistics master.
"Hmph," Thora finally grunted, turning her nose up. "One more chance... You break one more diamond, giantess, and I’m personally locking the pantry with a mythril deadbolt."
"THANK YOU, NOBLE SMITH!" Thor gasped, wiping phantom tears from her eyes as she scrambled back to her feet.
Thora whirled around, facing the rest of the women with her fierce dwarven authority radiating across the shimmering geode.

"WELL?!" Thora barked at the top of her lungs, slamming the butt of her pickaxe into the stone. "WHAT ARE YOU LOT GAPING AT?! YOU HEARD THE LORD! WE HAVE A QUOTA TO FILL! SPREAD OUT, READ THE STONE, AND GET TO BLOODY WORK!"
"YES, MASTER THORA!"
With a unified roar, the women scattered across the glittering geode, their pickaxes rising into the prismatic light as the music of Blessed Land’s true harvest began.
The geode of Cavern KB-22 quickly transformed into a cathedral of rhythm and light.
The prismatic shafts of noon sun cutting through the ceiling fractures danced across a tempest of glittering dust.

At first, the women moved with hesitant jerky motions as their leather-clad fingers fumbled against the cold, jagged limestone walls, their knuckles raw and chalky as they tried to remember Thora’s strict dwarven lecture.
But once the initial fear of turning high-grade gems into gray dust faded, the discipline drilled into them on the training grounds took over...
Tink!
Tink!
Tink!
The sounds began to overlap in a crisp musical tune.
Near the western curvature of the chamber, Brenda pressed her bare palm against a jagged outcrop of rock.
Her freckled face scrunched up in intense concentration, her eyes shut tight as she felt the subtle hum-like vibrations of the subterranean earth.
"I feel it..." Brenda whispered under her breath.
Her eyelids snapped open.
Tracing a faint, discolored line running roughly eight inches beneath a protruding cluster of cerulean stones, she stepped back, set her boots wide, and swung.
TINK!
Her wrists snapped clean at the point of impact as the steel pickaxe sang.

A perfect circular hairline fracture spider-webbed across the rock, and a slab of outer limestone parted with a clean sliding scrape, tumbling away to reveal three uncut cerulean Mana Diamonds glowing in the shadows.

"Yes!" Brenda gasped, her face flushing with pure triumph as she carefully pried the pristine gems loose with a runic chisel and dropped them into her canvas haul-sack. "I did it! Not a single crack on the facets!"

"Don’t celebrate yet, rookie!" Helen called out from a few yards away, effortlessly dislodging a massive chunk of raw emerald diamond with a single fluid flick of her wrists. "We’ve got thousands of pounds to clear before the sun dips! Keep your spacing and keep your tempo!"
While the recruits worked in pairs, leaning heavily on technique and steady endurance, Aurelia moved with a serene grace that felt out of place in a damp mining cavern.
Her pristine white under-tunic glowed in the multicolored light, and her golden eyes sparkled with a playful light as she approached a vertical face of porous limestone.
Instead of swinging her heavy pickaxe with brute force, Aurelia treated the entire process like a sacred dance.
She pressed her slender palm flat against the stone as a microscopic tracing of pure Argent Flame flickered from her fingertips.
The warmth naturally expanded through the porous bleed-lines of the rock, gently softening the impurities surrounding the gem deposits.
Tink!
Aurelia tapped the outer boundary with the iron tip of her pickaxe.
CRRR-SLIDE!
An entire five-foot section of limestone separated cleanly, sliding down like butter to expose a breathtaking cascade of royal amethyst and cerulean diamonds.
’This is actually quite fun,’ Aurelia thought with a soft genuine smile gracing her porcelain features. ’Thank you my Lord...’
To simply stand in a glittering cavern, listen to the rhythmic music of pickaxes, and harvest the bounties of the earth for the man who had sheltered her soul... it felt remarkably light.
It felt peaceful.
A few paces deeper into the geode, however, peace was entirely absent.
TINK-TINK-TINK-TINK-TINK!𝙛𝒓𝒆𝙚𝒘𝒆𝓫𝙣𝓸𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝒄𝒐𝓶
The strikes came so fast they sounded like a hail of iron ballista bolts.
Thor was a terrifying blur of blonde hair and boundless divine energy.
Having received the fear of the gods from Thora’s earlier threat of a territorial food embargo, the God of Thunder was working with mad desperation.
She didn’t dare channel her thunder, nor did she dare swing with her colossal back muscles.
Instead, she relied purely on her supernatural lightning-fast reflexes and wrist articulation.
Tink! Tink! Tink!
Her pickaxe danced across the limestone walls like a humming woodpecker.

Her massive gravity-defying chest heaved against the tight leather harness with every breath, beads of sweat glistening across her collarbone and running down the chiseled valley of her abdominal muscles.
Every single flick of her wrists sent hairline fractures shooting through the stone with perfection.

Huge slabs of limestone buckled and fell away, and Thor would swiftly catch the exposed Mana Diamonds with her bare hands, tossing them behind her into an ever-growing pile before immediately striking the next seam.
Within twenty minutes, the pile of harvested gems behind Thor looked like a small shimmering hill.

"Gwahahaha!" Thor laughed under her breath, a nervous sweat beading on her brow as she wiped her forehead with a soot-stained forearm. "Take that, mountain! Clean facets and not a single grain of dust! The ale is saved! The boar meat remains on the spit!"

The geode of Cavern KB-22 quickly transformed into a cathedral of rhythm and light.
The prismatic shafts of noon sun cutting through the ceiling fractures danced across a tempest of glittering dust.

At first, the women moved with hesitant jerky motions as their leather-clad fingers fumbled against the cold, jagged limestone walls, their knuckles raw and chalky as they tried to remember Thora’s strict dwarven lecture.
But once the initial fear of turning high-grade gems into gray dust faded, the discipline drilled into them on the training grounds took over...
Tink!
Tink!
Tink!
The sounds began to overlap in a crisp musical tune.
Near the western curvature of the chamber, Brenda pressed her bare palm against a jagged outcrop of rock.
Her freckled face scrunched up in intense concentration, her eyes shut tight as she felt the subtle hum-like vibrations of the subterranean earth.
"I feel it..." Brenda whispered under her breath.
Her eyelids snapped open.
Tracing a faint, discolored line running roughly eight inches beneath a protruding cluster of cerulean stones, she stepped back, set her boots wide, and swung.
TINK!
Her wrists snapped clean at the point of impact as the steel pickaxe sang.

A perfect circular hairline fracture spider-webbed across the rock, and a slab of outer limestone parted with a clean sliding scrape, tumbling away to reveal three uncut cerulean Mana Diamonds glowing in the shadows.
"Yes!" Brenda gasped, her face flushing with pure triumph as she carefully pried the pristine gems loose with a runic chisel and dropped them into her canvas haul-sack.
"I did it!
Not a single crack on the facets!"
"Don’t celebrate yet, rookie!" Helen called out from a few yards away, effortlessly dislodging a massive chunk of raw emerald diamond with a single fluid flick of her wrists.
"We’ve got thousands of pounds to clear before the sun dips!
Keep your spacing and keep your tempo!"
While the recruits worked in pairs, leaning heavily on technique and steady endurance, Aurelia moved with a serene grace that felt out of place in a damp mining cavern.
Her pristine white under-tunic glowed in the multicolored light, and her golden eyes sparkled with a playful light as she approached a vertical face of porous limestone.
Instead of swinging her heavy pickaxe with brute force, Aurelia treated the entire process like a sacred dance.
She pressed her slender palm flat against the stone as a microscopic tracing of pure Argent Flame flickered from her fingertips.
The warmth naturally expanded through the porous bleed-lines of the rock, gently softening the impurities surrounding the gem deposits.
Tink!
Aurelia tapped the outer boundary with the iron tip of her pickaxe.
CRRR-SLIDE!
An entire five-foot section of limestone separated cleanly, sliding down like butter to expose a breathtaking cascade of royal amethyst and cerulean diamonds.
’This is actually quite fun,’ Aurelia thought with a soft genuine smile gracing her porcelain features. ’Thank you my Lord...’
To simply stand in a glittering cavern, listen to the rhythmic music of pickaxes, and harvest the bounties of the earth for the man who had sheltered her soul... it felt remarkably light.
It felt peaceful.
A few paces deeper into the geode, however, peace was entirely absent.
TINK-TINK-TINK-TINK-TINK!𝙛𝒓𝒆𝙚𝒘𝒆𝓫𝙣𝓸𝙫𝓮𝒍.𝒄𝒐𝓶
The strikes came so fast they sounded like a hail of iron ballista bolts.
Thor was a terrifying blur of blonde hair and boundless divine energy.
Having received the fear of the gods from Thora’s earlier threat of a territorial food embargo, the God of Thunder was working with mad desperation.
She didn’t dare channel her thunder, nor did she dare swing with her colossal back muscles.
Instead, she relied purely on her supernatural lightning-fast reflexes and wrist articulation.
Tink!
Tink!
Tink!
Her pickaxe danced across the limestone walls like a humming woodpecker.

Her massive gravity-defying chest heaved against the tight leather harness with every breath, beads of sweat glistening across her collarbone and running down the chiseled valley of her abdominal muscles.
Every single flick of her wrists sent hairline fractures shooting through the stone with perfection.

Huge slabs of limestone buckled and fell away, and Thor would swiftly catch the exposed Mana Diamonds with her bare hands, tossing them behind her into an ever-growing pile before immediately striking the next seam.
Within twenty minutes, the pile of harvested gems behind Thor looked like a small shimmering hill.
"Gwahahaha!" Thor laughed under her breath, a nervous sweat beading on her brow as she wiped her forehead with a soot-stained forearm.
"Take that, mountain!
Clean facets and not a single grain of dust!
The ale is saved!
The boar meat remains on the spit!"

chapters.title: Chapter 484: Popping Up From The Ground
paragraphs: Over by a lower alcove, the Princess was doing her absolute best to contribute.
Her royal upbringing had never prepared her for manual labor, but the twenty-five-year-old woman was determined not to be dead weight.
She knelt on the crystalline gravel, holding her runic chisel with both small hands while lightly tapping the end with a dwarven mallet.
Tap! Tap! Tap!
"Hnngh..." The Princess grunted softly, biting her lower lip in concentration.
With a satisfying pop, a loose, fist-sized cerulean diamond snapped free into her palms.
Her azure eyes lit up with radiant joy as she clutched the heavy glowing gem to her chest, beaming with pride before gingerly setting it atop the communal collection pile.
Gradually, the scattered harvesting converged into a massive central deposit in the center of the geode floor.
Hundreds upon hundreds of raw, uncut Mana Diamonds lay heaped together.
Cerulean blues, radiant emeralds, and deep royal amethysts pulsed and refracted the midday sunlight, casting a blinding multicolored glow across the cavern walls that made everyone’s shadows dance.
Thora stepped up to the edge of the glittering mountain of wealth, her clean-shaven face smudged with soot and dust.
She let out an appreciative whistle, planting her fists on her hips.

"Alright, that’s enough swinging for a moment, girls!" Thora barked, her raspy voice echoing off the limestone. "Hold your tools! The pile’s getting too tall to manage on foot! Let’s clear the floor before someone trips on a geode and breaks an ankle!"
The women lowered their pickaxes with collective relieved sighs, leaning against the walls to catch their breath and wipe the sweat from their brows.
Thora turned toward the narrow entrance fissure connecting the geode to the main outer cavern where the goblin settlement had once stood.
"Phase One Titan!" Thora shouted at the top of her lungs, channeling her mana into her voice. "Engage clearance protocol! Right arm through the gap! Scoop and load!"
KRRRRRR-GRIND!
Out in the main chamber, the colossal construct stirred.
The Phase 1 Titan Golem which had been resting flat on its belly in a low-power sleeping posture slowly flared its central amber optics.𝚏𝐫𝚎𝗲𝕨𝐞𝐛𝕟𝚘𝐯𝚎𝗹.𝕔𝐨𝗺
A deep pneumatic hiss echoed through the rock as its hydraulic joints engaged.
SHRRRRR-CLANG.
From the narrow fissure, a shadow swallowed the light.
The massive right arm of the titan construct... forged from thick slabs of volcanic bedrock and banded with dark Deep-Earth Alloy snaked carefully through the stone opening.
Its articulated stone fingers, each as thick as a tree trunk, expanded with a mechanical hum.
With surprisingly delicate precision, the golem lowered its massive stone palm beneath the glittering pile of gems.
The fingers curled inward, scooping up hundreds of pounds of raw Mana Diamonds in a single effortless sweep, cleanly clearing the floorboards.
The arm slowly retracted through the limestone opening, sliding back out into the main chamber.
Outside, the golem didn’t even bother standing.
Maintaining its grounded, resting posture, the construct swung its massive arm overhead and tilted its palm over the expansive transport bins bolted across its back.
RATTLE-CLATTER-CRASH!
A glorious cascading waterfall of precious gems poured into the alloy bins with a thunderous roar.
Watching the volume of wealth effortlessly disappear into the construct’s payload, Thora couldn’t contain herself.
"GWAHAHAHAHAHA!"
The dwarven forge master threw her head back, letting out a wild cackle that made several of the recruits jump.

"Look at it! Just look at it!" Thora roared, slapping her thigh with glee. "That’s pure capital! We’re going to drown the world in high-tier mana! We’ll be forging runic cannons out of pure diamond by next week!"
Her manic laughter echoed off the high ceiling yet, slowly... one by one... the girls stopped paying attention to Thora.
The laughter, the chatter, the clinking of water canteens... it all gradually began to fade into a strange suffocating silence.
Thora blinked, her wild cackling abruptly cutting off as she looked around.
"What? Why’d you lot go quiet all of a—"
She followed their gazes.
At the far eastern wall of the geode, completely isolated from the rest of the group, Silas was still working.
The Lord hadn’t stopped as while everyone else had paused for the golem’s extraction, Silas remained in a steady rhythm.

Beside his boots lay his own massive personal haul of raw Mana Diamonds... a pristine mountain of deep cerulean and crimson-tinged stones that rivaled the entire squad’s combined efforts but nobody was looking at the gems.
Every single female eye in the cavern was locked directly onto his body.
Silas had unbuttoned the high collar of his mining shirt, letting the rough fabric part slightly at his chest.
The custom-tailored leather harness... the very one he had complained was far too tight earlier clung ruthlessly to his frame like a second skin.
With every swing, the broad chiseled expanse of his back flexed with terrifying sculpted power.
The dark straps cut deeply into the dense musculature of his shoulders and lats, defining every ridge and striation of his physique.
Sweat glistened across the back of his neck and ran in slow agonizingly hot rivulets down the center of his spine, soaking through the thin linen beneath the leather harness.
Tink!
His movements were hypnotic as there was no rushing and no wasted force.

He moved with the effortless breathtaking precision of a master martial artist as his wrists snapped with fluid whip-like perfection, the pickaxe striking the rock in a mesmerizing way that sent clean slabs of limestone sliding away to reveal flawless gems beneath.
The recruit maidens stood completely frozen, their lips parted and their cheeks burning with bright feverish flushes.
Brenda subconsciously swallowed hard, her fingers clutching the handle of her mallet so tightly her knuckles turned white.
Sarah’s eyes were practically glued to the dip of his waist where the leather cinched tight around his hips.
Even Aurelia stood transfixed, her delicate fingers resting against her lips, her golden eyes softening into a warm fascinated gaze that lingered on the rhythmic flex of his arms.

Beside her, the Princess’s face was a volcanic shade of crimson. She stared at Silas’s glistening, muscular back, her small hands trembling slightly as she subconsciously twisted the hem of her leather harness, completely captivated.
The only person in the entire cavern who wasn’t staring at Silas’s body was Thor.
The God of Thunder was sitting flat on a limestone boulder, leaning her chin heavily on her palm, staring blankly at the ceiling while her stomach let out a thunderous cavern-shaking rumble.

’Roasted boar...’ Thor mused in a daze with a thin line of drool pooling at the corner of her lips. ’Crispy skin... dipped in sweet mustard and washed down with five gallons of dark stout... Ah, by Odin’s beard, I could eat an entire herd of swine right now...’
Meanwhile, Silas drove his chisel into the rock one last time, dislodging a fist-sized emerald stone.
Tink!
Suddenly, a strange prickling sensation crawled up the back of his neck.
’What is that?’ Silas thought with his blue eyes narrowing sharply. ’The air feels... suffocating.’
It felt like dozens of microscopic lasers were boring straight through his back and burning into his skin.
Silas lowered his pickaxe and whipped around, his hand instinctively dropping toward the hilt of his golden sword as he swept his gaze across the geode.
SWOOSH.
In a single coordinated blur, all the women instantly snapped their heads back to the walls.
Tink! Tink! Tink! Bang! Clang!
The cavern immediately erupted into a deafening flurry of energetic mining.
"Keep swinging, girls! Great yield on this vein!" Helen shouted with unnatural strained enthusiasm, hammering a chisel into the rock so hard sparks flew.
"Yes, ma’am! Working hard!" Brenda squeaked, her face glowing red as she attacked a patch of limestone with desperate fury.

Aurelia was serenely examining an already-harvested amethyst with intense scholarly interest, while the Princess was vigorously polishing a diamond with her sleeve, her face buried so close to the stone she was practically kissing it.
Silas stood in the center of the alcove, holding his pickaxe, blinking in complete bewilderment.
He looked to the left and the girls were sweating and swinging.
He looked to the right and Thora was furiously scribbling nonsense numbers into her ledger.
He looked straight ahead and Thor was still drooling over imaginary pork.
Silas scratched the back of his neck, letting out a quiet confused breath.
’Weird...’ Silas thought, shaking his head as he turned back to the rock face. ’I could have sworn I was being watched just now.’
RUMBLE... KRRRR-CRUNCH!
The rhythmic chime of steel pickaxes striking limestone ceased in an instant.
Beneath Silas’s heavy mining boots, the solid bedrock of Cavern KB-22 gave a violent, sickening lurch.
The fine crystalline gravel danced, skipping across the floor as deep concussive seismic tremors tore through the cavern floor.
From the ceiling thirty feet above, shards of calcified rock and loose crystals rained down, shattering across the shale.
’A monster?’ Silas’s thoughts moved at terminal velocity. ’Did the vibrations of the Titan Golem’s extraction wake an ancient burrower?... An earth-drake? What tier?!’
"WEAPONS! CATCH, YOU LOT!"
Thora didn’t hesitate for a second.

The dwarven forge master kicked open the emergency alloy trunks with a thunderous bang, snatching armfuls of void-iron blades, spears, and sidearms and hurling them across the geode like spinning projectiles.
"Formation! Tighten the circle!" Helen barked, her hand snapping out to snatch her ash-wood spear from mid-air.
Sarah caught her void-iron arming sword with a crisp metallic slide, while Brenda grabbed her shield, planting her stance wide beside the Princess.
Aurelia glided backward with effortless grace, the pristine white orb of Argent Flame flaring around her fingertips.
Silas didn’t even have time to reach for his golden sword.

He remained locked in place, his fingers tightening around the heavy runic-forged dwarven pickaxe in his grip, ready to use the tool’s tempered spike to split the skull of whatever monstrosity broke through the floor.
The violent vibration wasn’t coming from the walls, they all knew that... it was coming directly from beneath them.
KRA-BOOOOOOOOM!
Right in the center of the geode floor, barely ten paces from Silas’s boots, the limestone violently ruptured outward in a geyser of pulverized rock and white chalk.
A jagged, human-sized hole blew open from below, jagged cracks spider-webbing across the foundation.
"STRIKE!" Brenda yelled, leveling her spear.
"Burn it to ash!" Sarah shouted with her blade flashing.
Every single woman drew back their weapons, mana flaring across the room in a deadly synchronized execution arc—
Except for Thor.
The God of Thunder remained comfortably perched on her limestone boulder, a finger casually picking her ear as she looked down at the hole with an amused half-bored squint.
POP!
Before a single blade could plunge into the dark opening, a figure shot straight up through the jagged crater like a cork bursting from an over-pressurized champagne bottle.
"GWAHAHAHAHAHA!"
The concussive boisterous laughter echoed off the crystalline walls with enough volume to rattle everyone’s eardrums.
Covered from head to toe in pulverized stone dust, dried black monster ichor, and tangled copper hair, Brida hauled herself out of the breach.
She planted her boots firmly onto the geode floor, casually tossing her massive Titan’s Cleaver over her shoulder while shaking chalk from her wild red locks like a dog shedding water.
The recruits froze mid-thrust, blinking in dumbfounded shock.
Silas stood with his pickaxe raised high, his eye twitching as he stared at the breathless brawler.
Brida didn’t look at the weapons pointed at her throat and she completely ignored Thora’s dropped jaw as well as Aurelia’s startled blink.
Her bright crimson eyes locked straight onto Silas.

Taking in his sweat-sheened chest, the tight leather harness cinched across his sculpted torso, and the breathtaking sight of her Lord in full mining attire, a grin split across her soot-stained face.
She marched straight up to him, puffing out her battered chestplate, and planted her armored hands on her hips.

"My Lord!" Brida announced proudly, her voice booming through the silent cavern with zero shame. "Pack up the picks! I just butchered an entire hive of shapeshifting parasites all by myself, shattered their four-armed alpha, and carved a three-mile trench straight to your doorstep!"
She leaned in, her eyes burning with hunger as she looked up into his face.
"I performed a feat so legendary it’s going to make you want to breed me all alone tonight!"
